instruction: You are given the text of one tax document. Report every amount in it that matches one of these facts: {facts}. Answer with a JSON list and nothing else. Each item is an object with three keys: fact, one of the names above; amount, the figure as it appears; quote, the exact line of the document the figure is printed on, copied character for character. Report a fact only if the document shows it. Report nothing you have to work out or assume. If the document shows none of these facts, answer with an empty list.

fields.salary: the total emoluments or gross pay for the year, before anything is taken off
fields.taxable_transport_allowance: the taxable part of a travelling or transport allowance
fields.statutory_bonus: the end of year bonus the law requires
fields.other_income: income that is neither pay nor from a business
fields.losses_brought_forward: a loss from an earlier year carried into this one
fields.resident_dividends: a dividend from a company resident in the same place as the taxpayer
fields.housing_loan_interest: interest paid on a loan for the taxpayer's home
fields.medical_insurance: a premium paid for medical or health insurance
fields.other_reliefs: any other relief or deduction claimed
fields.paye_withheld: tax already taken off the pay by the employer
fields.tax_deducted_at_source: tax already taken off at source by a payer other than an employer
fields.quarterly_tax_paid: tax already paid in quarterly instalments
